items.title: Osaka Public University — ~500 servers down
items.summary: Ransomware hit the university's virtualization layer on Oct 2, taking nearly 500 servers offline and encrypting many backups; classes were suspended until Oct 9.

items.title: DexCom claimed by Redact
items.summary: The Redact group listed US medical-device maker DexCom on its leak site on Oct 10; the claim is unconfirmed by the company.

items.title: Andersen Group claimed by SilentRansomGroup
items.summary: SilentRansomGroup claimed an attack on the US professional-services firm on Oct 6, alleging system disruption and a payment demand.

items.title: SilentRansomGroup posts more partially-redacted victims
items.summary: The group posted additional victims on Oct 5 and Oct 7 with names withheld pending disclosure, consistent with its data-extortion playbook.

items.title: September ransomware volume up sharply year over year
items.summary: Bitdefender counted 790 claimed victims in September 2026 (+30% YoY) and Check Point reported ransomware attacks up 53% YoY for the month.

ransomware.note: Most October victims are leak-site claims, not confirmed disclosures.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2 regional outage
items.summary: A ~5.5-hour regional incident starting 08:35 UTC Oct 20 affected twelve services in London including Compute Engine, App Engine and Cloud Storage.

outage.note: Quiet stretch: no other major AWS, Azure or SaaS outages found in the past two weeks. Google item is from a third-party monitor; confirm against Google's status history.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure auth-bypass exploited as zero-day
items.summary: CISA urged immediate patching of an unauthenticated RCE in Ivanti Connect Secure exploited since at least Oct 1; Volexity ties chained attacks to actor UTA0576.

items.title: Zero-day pace running ahead of 2025
items.summary: Third-party tallies put KEV additions at 247 for Jan 1–Oct 1 2026 and exploited zero-days at ~11 a month, up from ~8 in 2025.

items.title: September 2026 zero-day vulnerability report
items.summary: Indusface's monthly roundup of zero-days disclosed and exploited during September 2026, useful for patch-backlog review.

items.title: M 7.0 — 191 km ENE of Nagqu, China
items.summary: Oct 22 shallow quake on the Tibetan Plateau; USGS PAGER alert orange, indicating significant potential casualties or losses.

items.title: M 6.9 — 197 km WNW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu
items.summary: Oct 24 quake with a tsunami flag, followed by an M 6.3 aftershock; PAGER green.

items.title: M 6.3 — 197 km NW of Port-Olry, Vanuatu
items.summary: Oct 20 foreshock-region event in the same Vanuatu sequence, tsunami flag set; PAGER green.

items.title: Hurricane Simon (Cat 4) strikes Mexico's Pacific coast
items.summary: Category 4 Hurricane Simon affected Mexico's Pacific coast around Oct 11, following Hurricane Polo in late September.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias landfall in Florida
items.summary: Isaias came ashore in Florida as a Category 2 around Oct 10, cutting power to thousands with at least four deaths reported.

physical.note: Hurricane items come from headline listings only; details not independently verified.
